Id1.text: Mexico inhabited by Mexicans with peso as its currency has Silvano Aureoles Conejo as one of its leaders. Bionico is served as a dessert in Mexico and comes from Guadalajara. It has chopped fruits, sour cream, condensed milk, granola, shredded coconut and raisins as its main ingredients.
